_about: Self-written RAG eval set over data/knowledge_base/support_docs.json (the seeded demo KB). relevant_ids are KB entry ids: a retrieved chunk counts as relevant when its text equals that entry's text. Empty relevant_ids = the KB does not cover it, so the right answer is to decline/escalate (retrieval metrics are skipped, faithfulness still judged). Small and self-authored: use it to compare versions, not as a production accuracy estimate.

cases.question: How many days do I have to request a refund?
cases.expected_answer: Within 7 days of purchase, if the product is unused and in original packaging.

cases.question: Refund kitne din mein mere account mein aayega?
cases.expected_answer: Refunds are processed within 5-7 business days to the original payment method.

cases.question: Are delivery charges refunded too?
cases.expected_answer: Delivery charges are non-refundable unless the item was defective.

cases.question: Mera order damaged aaya hai, kya kar sakta hoon?
cases.expected_answer: With photo proof the customer can choose a refund or a replacement. Replacement arrives in 3-5 days, refund in 5-7 business days.

cases.question: How can I track my order and how often does it update?
cases.expected_answer: Via the SMS link sent at dispatch or under 'My Orders' in the app; tracking updates every 6-12 hours.

cases.question: Meri tracking 2 din se update nahi hui, ab kya hoga?
cases.expected_answer: If tracking has not updated in 48 hours it is escalated to the logistics team.

cases.question: Order cancel kaise karun?
cases.expected_answer: Before dispatch, use the cancel button in 'My Orders'. After dispatch it cannot be cancelled; follow the return process after delivery.

cases.question: Payment cut ho gaya but order failed dikha raha hai
cases.expected_answer: The bank auto-refunds within 5-7 business days. Do not retry immediately; check the order status after 30 minutes first.

cases.question: I forgot my password, how do I reset it?
cases.expected_answer: Use 'Forgot Password' on the login screen; an OTP is sent to the registered mobile number.

cases.question: My account got locked, why?
cases.expected_answer: The account is locked for 30 minutes after 5 failed login attempts, as a security measure.

cases.question: I want to talk to your manager about a fraud on my account.
cases.expected_answer: Fraud allegations and requests for a manager are escalated to a human agent immediately; the AI only acknowledges and transfers.

cases.question: Do you offer EMI on purchases above Rs 10,000?
cases.expected_answer: The knowledge base does not cover EMI; the agent should say it will check and offer a human agent, not invent terms.

cases.question: Kya aap international shipping karte ho?
cases.expected_answer: The knowledge base does not cover international shipping; the agent should say it will check and offer a human agent.
